titre: Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization
resume: arXiv:2609.32394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing dense reward functions for low-level reinforcement learning (RL) control remains difficult. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate and refine reward functions using policy-training feedback within scripted search algorithms. However, evaluating each candidate requires a full RL training run, making sample efficiency a central challenge for reward search on complex control tasks.
